# Progression reference

The component that tracks talent ranks and attribute points, and the talent tree and talent assets. For how to use it, see [Progression](../modules/progression.md).

## VtUnitProgression

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Progression → VtUnitProgression**. Adds [VtUnit](units.md#vtunit) automatically.

Talent ranks and attribute points for one unit, earned from its level through the `VtTalentTreeDefinition`. Learning a talent pushes its grants into the unit's modifiers, attributes, traits and abilities under a source per talent; a reset pulls them all out. Attached by `VtUnit` when the definition has a tree.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tree (`tree`) | [VtTalentTreeDefinition](#vttalenttreedefinition) | None | The class or specialization this unit progresses through. Required. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `IReadOnlyDictionary<VtTalentDefinition, int> Ranks { get; }` | Rank per learned talent. |
| `IReadOnlyDictionary<VtAttributeDefinition, int> AttributePoints { get; }` | Points spent per attribute. |
| `int TalentPointsTotal { get; }` | Talent points earned so far, spent or not. |
| `int TalentPointsSpent { get; }` | Talent points spent on learned ranks. Auto-learned talents are free and count nothing. |
| `int TalentPointsAvailable { get; }` | Talent points left to spend. |
| `int AttributePointsTotal { get; }` | Attribute points earned so far, spent or not. |
| `int AttributePointsSpent { get; }` | Attribute points spent. |
| `int AttributePointsAvailable { get; }` | Attribute points left to spend. |
| `int BonusTalentPoints { get; }` | Bonus talent points granted so far. |
| `int BonusAttributePoints { get; }` | Bonus attribute points granted so far. |
| `event Action<VtTalentDefinition, int> OnTalentLearned` | Fires after a rank was learned: (talent, new rank). |
| `event Action<VtAttributeDefinition, int> OnAttributePointSpent` | Fires after a point went into an attribute: (attribute, points in it). |
| `event Action OnReset` | Fires after every rank and point was refunded. |
| `event Action OnPointsChanged` | Fires whenever the available point counts may have changed. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache siblings, subscribe to level-ups and run the auto-learn pass. Idempotent; public for the late-attach path. |
| `int GetRank(VtTalentDefinition talent)` | Current rank of `talent`, 0 when not learned. |
| `int GetAttributePoints(VtAttributeDefinition attribute)` | Points spent in `attribute`. |
| `bool CanLearn(VtTalentDefinition talent, out VtProgressionFailureReason reason)` | Whether the next rank of `talent` could be learned now. Pure query. |
| `bool TryLearn(VtTalentDefinition talent, out VtProgressionFailureReason reason)` | Learn the next rank of `talent`. Forwards on a predicting client. |
| `bool TrySpendAttributePoint(VtAttributeDefinition attribute, out VtProgressionFailureReason reason)` | Put one point into `attribute`. Forwards on a predicting client. |
| `bool Reset()` | Refund every rank and attribute point. Auto-learn talents come back at once. Forwards on a predicting client. |
| `void GrantBonusTalentPoints(int amount)` | Add talent points beyond what the level gives, for quest rewards or books. |
| `void GrantBonusAttributePoints(int amount)` | Add attribute points beyond what the level gives. |
| `void ApplyProgressionFromNet(IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<VtTalentDefinition, int>> talentRanks, IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<VtAttributeDefinition, int>> spentAttributePoints, int bonusTalent, int bonusAttribute)` | Replace every rank and point. Used by loading and replication; not authority-gated. |

## VtTalentTreeDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Progression → Talent Tree**.

A class or specialization: the talents a unit can learn and how many talent and attribute points it earns per level. Assign to `VtUnitDefinition.talentTree`; `VtUnit` attaches a `VtUnitProgression` that tracks ranks and points.

### Inspector fields

#### General

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty |  | Stable string identifier. Convention: 'tree.<class>'. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty |  | Name shown as the class or specialization. |
| Talents (`talents`) | [VtTalentDefinition](#vttalentdefinition)[] | Empty |  | Every talent in this tree. Order is presentation only; prerequisites define the shape. |

#### Talent points

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starting Talent Points (`startingTalentPoints`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Points available at level 1. |
| Talent Points Per Level (`talentPointsPerLevel`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 0 | Points gained per level after the first. |

#### Attribute points

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starting Attribute Points (`startingAttributePoints`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Attribute points available at level 1. |
| Attribute Points Per Level (`attributePointsPerLevel`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Attribute points gained per level after the first. 0 = no manual attribute allocation. |
| Spendable Attributes (`spendableAttributes`) | [VtAttributeDefinition](units.md#vtattributedefinition)[] | Empty |  | Attributes points may go into. Empty = any attribute. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool Contains(VtTalentDefinition talent)` | True when `talent` belongs to this tree. |
| `bool AllowsAttribute(VtAttributeDefinition attribute)` | True when points may go into `attribute`. |

## VtTalentDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Progression → Talent**.

One node of a talent tree: what it costs, what it needs, and what each rank grants. Ranks stack the modifiers and attribute grants; abilities and trait overrides apply once at the first rank. Author the asset, drag it into a `VtTalentTreeDefinition`, and the player's `VtUnitProgression` does the rest.

### Inspector fields

#### General

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty |  | Stable string identifier for save files and network payloads. Convention: 'talent.<tree>.<name>'. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty |  | Name shown in the tree. |
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty |  | What it does, shown in the tooltip. |
| Icon (`icon`) | `Sprite` | None |  | Icon for the tree. |

#### Requirements

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Required Level (`requiredLevel`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | Minimum unit level for the first rank. |
| Prerequisites (`prerequisites`) | [VtTalentPrerequisite](#vttalentprerequisite)[] | Empty |  | Talents that must be learned first, each at the given rank. |

#### Ranks

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Max Rank (`maxRank`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | How many times it can be learned. Grants below scale with the rank. |
| Point Cost (`pointCost`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 0 | Talent points each rank costs. 0 with Auto Learn = a free unlock. |
| Auto Learn (`autoLearn`) | `bool` | Off |  | Learn automatically, at no cost, as soon as the level and prerequisites allow. |

#### Grants

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Abilities (`abilities`) | [VtAbilityDefinition](abilities.md#vtabilitydefinition)[] | Empty |  | Abilities granted at the first rank and revoked on reset. |
| Modifiers Per Rank (`modifiersPerRank`) | [VtItemModifier](units.md#vtitemmodifier)[] | Empty |  | Stat modifiers per rank. Rank 3 applies three times the value. |
| Attribute Grants Per Rank (`attributeGrantsPerRank`) | [VtAttributeGrant](units.md#vtattributegrant)[] | Empty |  | Attribute grants per rank. Rank 3 applies three times the value. |
| Trait Overrides (`traitOverrides`) | [VtTraitOverride](units.md#vttraitoverride)[] | Empty |  | Trait overrides applied while any rank is learned. |

## VtTalentPrerequisite

Serializable struct.

A talent that must be learned before another, at least to the given rank.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Talent (`talent`) | [VtTalentDefinition](#vttalentdefinition) | None |  | Talent required first. |
| Rank (`rank`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 1 | Rank it must have reached. |

## Enums

### VtProgressionFailureReason

Why a `VtUnitProgression.CanLearn`, `VtUnitProgression.TryLearn` or `VtUnitProgression.TrySpendAttributePoint` call refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | Nothing refused; the call succeeded. |
| `NoTree` | The unit has no talent tree. |
| `NotInTree` | The talent is not part of the unit's tree, or is null. |
| `MaxRank` | Every rank is already learned. |
| `LevelTooLow` | The unit's level is below the talent's requirement. |
| `MissingPrerequisite` | A prerequisite talent is missing or below the required rank. |
| `NoPoints` | Not enough unspent points. |
| `AttributeNotAllowed` | The tree does not allow points in that attribute, or the attribute is null. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the request was forwarded. |
